statement: Vasumati Yoga (natural benefics occupying the upachaya houses -- 3rd, 6th, 10th, or 11th) is traditionally read as carrying prosperity and comfort that build and increase progressively over a lifetime, rather than being present from birth.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
